description: Microsoft Word 2010 is open with a blank document. (3) Recipient address: 'Ms. Rebecca Johnson, Director of Operations, Pinnacle Solutions Inc., 1200 Market Street, Philadelphia, PA 19107'. (4) Salutation: 'Dear Ms. Johnson:'.
